probe_ref.label: ANTEFLEX
probe_ref.desc: Tip bends anteriorly toward imaging face — brings heart closer to probe

probe_ref.label: RETROFLEX
probe_ref.desc: Tip bends posteriorly — moves heart away from probe

probe_ref.label: ROTATE LEFT
probe_ref.desc: Shaft CCW — image plane sweeps leftward

probe_ref.label: ROTATE RIGHT
probe_ref.desc: Shaft CW — image plane sweeps rightward

probe_ref.label: ADVANCE
probe_ref.desc: Push distally toward stomach — increases depth (display depth ↑)

probe_ref.label: WITHDRAW
probe_ref.desc: Pull proximally toward mouth — decreases depth

probe_ref.label: CHANGE OMNI
probe_ref.desc: Adjust omniplane angle without any probe movement

doppler_pearls: CW/PW accuracy requires beam ≤ 20° from flow — use TG LAX or Deep TG for AV gradient. ME 4C / ME 5C for MR CW Doppler. ME RV I-O for TR CW (often ~45°). PA sys = CVP + 4(VTR)² | LA mean = Sys LVP − 4(VMR)² | MV area = 220/PHT_t | Continuity: LVOT area × LVOT VTI = AV area × AV VTI → AVA = 0.785 × D² × VTIlvot / VTIav

sweep_phases.label: PHASE 1
sweep_phases.title: ME FORWARD SWEEP
sweep_phases.desc: Begin ME, omniplane 0°. Sweep forward tracking one focal structure (e.g. mitral valve, LAA, or interatrial septum) as the angle advances. LV/MV-focused.
sweep_phases.mapping: #1 ME 4C (0°) → #5 ME AV SAX (30°) → #19 ME Commissural (60°) → #2 ME 2C (90°) → #4 ME Bicaval (110°) → #3 ME LAX (135°)

sweep_phases.label: PHASE 2
sweep_phases.title: ME REVERSE SWEEP
sweep_phases.desc: Using the aortic valve as the new reference point, reduce the angle back down, reassessing AV/RV structures on the way.
sweep_phases.mapping: #7 ME AV LAX (135°) → #6 ME RV Inflow-Outflow (80°) → back through 0°

sweep_phases.label: PHASE 3
sweep_phases.title: TRANSGASTRIC
sweep_phases.desc: Advance the probe into the stomach. Image at each fixed angle before withdrawing back to the mid-esophagus.
sweep_phases.mapping: #14 TG Basal SAX → #15 TG Mid-Pap SAX → #20 TG RV 2C (100°) → #16 TG 2C (90°) → #17 TG Long Axis (120°) → #18 Deep TG LAX

sweep_phases.label: PHASE 4
sweep_phases.title: WITHDRAWAL SWEEP
sweep_phases.desc: Withdraw the probe from the body, assessing the thoracic aorta and pulmonary artery along the way.
sweep_phases.mapping: #8/#9 ME Asc Ao SAX/LAX → #10/#11 Desc Ao SAX/LAX → #12/#13 UE Aortic Arch LAX/SAX
